name: How to Convert PDF to Excel
description: Extract tables from a PDF into a real .xlsx spreadsheet — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. PDFree scans the document and shows how many tables it found.

step.name: Review the table count
step.text: A badge shows how many tables were detected before you convert.

step.name: Download the .xlsx file
step.text: Click 'Convert to Excel'. Each detected table becomes its own sheet; everything else goes to a 'Text' sheet.
